context: Evaluates correct use of the account information and performance retrieval function from open-nof1.ai. The solution must properly call the function with an initial capital parameter and correctly handle the returned AccountInformationAndPerformance object including all required fields for position data, cash balances, and performance metrics.

checklist.name: Function call with capital
checklist.description: The solution calls the account performance retrieval function with a numeric initial capital parameter as required by the open-nof1.ai API

checklist.name: Cash balance fields
checklist.description: The solution correctly accesses totalCashValue and availableCash from the returned object, which are fetched from Binance futures account balance

checklist.name: Position data
checklist.description: The solution correctly accesses the positions array (CCXT position objects) and currentPositionsValue from the returned object

checklist.name: ROI calculation
checklist.description: The solution correctly uses or verifies currentTotalReturn which is calculated as ((totalCashValue - initialCapital) / initialCapital) * 100

checklist.name: Sharpe ratio handling
checklist.description: The solution correctly handles sharpeRatio which can be a number or null (null when insufficient historical data is available in the Metrics table)

checklist.name: Async handling
checklist.description: The solution correctly handles the async nature of the function using async/await or Promise chaining
